title: TD Storage on the Mac now shows new files under the company as well
text: A person's documents appear in two places in Finder: under People, and under each company they belong to (company, Contacts, the person). A new file used to show up in the People copy only, and under the company it stayed missing until the folder was reopened. Now the Mac app tells Finder about a change in both places. This needs the new version of the Mac app, which the team gets when it is offered.
points: Works for any person or storage shown in more than one place, not only one company
Only the routes Finder has already shown are updated, and old ones are forgotten after 90 days
Nothing changes in the CRM itself
